matchups.tips: | Whoever engages first on the other might be worse off in the fight as he puts himself in danger first which will then be extended by the enemies CC. You can hook him out of his W-Q combo if you time it right.
| Ashe can be very annoying in lane, but if you're able to hit a hook on her she'll be in mayor trouble. She doesn't scale very well either as she only really has her ult lategame.
| Bard will be looking to leave the lane early on which suits you just fine. Make sure to set your adc up for success and then roam around.

| Blitzcrank is generally going to be faster than you when it comes to making picks as both he and his hook are very fast, but you make up for it by being tankier and generating far more peel for your teammates.
| If you can't reach Brand he will slowly poke you down, make liberal use of your W to keep your health up and look for engages often.

| Braum will protect his Adc in lane, making it quite difficult to make kills happen, but whenever you have a choice of hooking him or his Adc aim for the Adc. This way you will either hit the Adc or Braum who will have jumped to them with his W to either dodge or block your hook. Your Ult will not be blocked by his shield.
| Extremely squishy, don't get poked too much and look for fights whenever he wastes his E spells.
| Janna can deny your travel with your hook if timed correctly, try to control bushes to throw out hooks before she can react with her Q.

| Engage on her after she uses her Ult as it's a big part of her combat power. Try not to let her take bush control and try to alternate where you stand in the bush so she can't just blind hit you on repeat in bushes.
| Leona is very similar to Nautilus so this lane can be quite difficult. Your hook can cancel her E travel so use it on her in response.
| Lulu isn't that strong right now in general, so if you're able to shut down her Adc she might not scale at all.
| Engage on her when she misses her Q and you will be favored.
| Maokai is really strong currently and he can use his W to dodge your hook and Ult. He will try to roam so try to match him.
| Milio is an annoying matchup as he can use his Q to deny your travel with hook and he will scale very well into the late game. If he ever uses his Q for poke look for a fight.
| She can use her E to deny your hook, but if she doesn't use it right away and instead uses it to block your ult you can break the shield with your magic damage to then get your ult off anyways.

| Don't underestimate her damage and slows. If you ever fail an engage and hit a wall or a minion she and her lane partner can chase you down with her slows, dealing a lot of damage on you as you retreat.
| Kind of a skill matchup, just remember that his Ult doesn't care about shields so make sure to use your W before you reach the health threshold.

| Rakan will be difficult to lockdown and he can also provide a lot of peel for his teammates when they get engaged on. You should try to aim hooks at his teammates instead of him because he might dash towards his teammates.
| Rell is very strong in early fights and she can break your shield with her Q. In response you can hook her out of her W jump.
| Renata thrives against engage comps and Nautilus doesn't really have any ways of getting out after his engage. Try not to fight in tight jungle corridors.
| Senna will scale extremely hard into the lategame. Punish her early game as she is very squishy if you hit just one hook on her.
| Seraphine scales well into engage comps, but her early game is very weak. Try to hook her as she is channeling her E as she will be standing still for a short while.
| Sona is really weak early game so make sure to capitalize on that so she'll have a harder time scaling up.
| Soraka is really squishy and will lose hp as she heals her Adc. Don't get hit by her Q as that will heal her and make her W heal cost less HP.
| After lvl 6 you will not really be able to kill him without ignite. He will become quite a problem.
| Tahm Kench is very frustrating to play against when you're playing engage. He becomes very tanky and hard to kill.
| Thresh can provide a lot of peel to protect his teammates, but also pick off your teammates if they missposition. You can hook his teammate out of his lantern.
| Free lane. If she ever jumps off her Adc you can just auto attack her to CC her with your passive and then she can't jump back for a while, making her an easy target to run down.
| Her plants can block your hooks and she will do a lot of annoying poke in lane. Later on she will do a lot of damage to tanks as yourself.
